description: Structural vocabulary of the 공문/기안문 document family, as data. check_gongmun.py carries no Korean literals: every term below is regulation-level (it appears in every 기안문, not in one file), never a per-file string. 'labels' are section markers that legitimately remain in a finished document — the gongmun keep-list; 'placeholders' are the guide terms the 별지서식 비고 block declares must NOT be displayed ('그 용어는 표시하지 아니하고 그 내용을 적는다'), i.e. the residue class. Each form's own 비고 block is parsed at run time too (bigo_quoted_term_re), so a 서식 naming a term this table misses is still covered. Term matching is whitespace-insensitive because the 서식 letter-spaces its labels ('행 정 기 관 명', '( 제    목 )').
